items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Very funny guy. And Gil and I were in the airport in Rome one time years ago.

ctx.x: No. No, I don’t. Oh, that’s funny. Joey… not Joey. Gil Goldstein has perfect pitch. And which, it’s kinda funny in a way. He’s incredible. Very funny guy. And Gil and I were in the airport in Rome one time years ago. And a couple of funny things happened there. There had been some kind of violent incident there. This is before all the 9/11 and everything. And there were lots of young guys with… guards with guns around and stuff and very suspicious of everybody. And the guy who was kind of booking the thing… we…
Take a sip [referring to Jim’s coffee].
